form.label: Persistence & Tampering
form.description: Someone setting up a way back in, or trying to blind you.

html.p: Severity 6. Someone wiped a Windows event log to hide what they did. Playbook steps (page 10)

search.query: (`windows_security` EventCode=1102) OR (`windows_system` EventCode=104) | eval who=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | table _time host source who

html.p: Severity 5. Sysmon or the Splunk forwarder stopped, or Sysmon's config changed. Playbook steps (page 12)

search.query: (`windows_sysmon` ((EventCode=4 State="Stopped") OR EventCode=16)) OR (`windows_system` EventCode=7036 "stopped" ("Sysmon" OR "Splunk")) | table _time host source EventCode State Configuration Message

panel.title: Alert: Defender turned off or exclusion added

html.p: Severity 5. Defender protection was turned off or a scanning exclusion was added. Playbook steps (page 10)

search.query: `windows_defender` (EventCode=5001 OR EventCode=5010 OR EventCode=5012 OR (EventCode=5007 "Exclusions")) | table _time host EventCode Message

html.p: Severity 5. Defender found malware or acted on it. Playbook steps (page 10) · Run the scope search

search.query: `windows_defender` EventCode IN (1116,1117) | table _time host EventCode Name Path Process_Name User

panel.title: Alert: Autorun or IFEO registry change

html.p: Severity 5. A Run key, Winlogon value or sticky-keys debugger was set. Playbook steps (page 11)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode IN (12,13,14) (TargetObject="*CurrentVersion*Run*" OR TargetObject="*Winlogon*Userinit*" OR TargetObject="*Winlogon*Shell*" OR TargetObject="*Image File Execution Options*Debugger*") NOT TargetObject="*RunMRU*" | table _time host User Image EventType TargetObject Details

html.p: Severity 5. A WMI subscription that runs a command was created: a hidden way back in. Playbook steps (page 11)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode IN (19,20,21) | table _time host User EventType Operation Name Query Destination Consumer Filter

panel.title: Alert: Script host running a disguised file

html.p: Severity 5. wscript or cscript was forced to run a non-script file with //E:, like JScript hidden in a file named like a log. Playbook steps (page 12)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 Image IN ("*wscript.exe","*cscript.exe") CommandLine="*//E:*" | table _time host User ParentImage CommandLine ProcessId

html.p: Severity 4. A new scheduled task was registered. Playbook steps (page 13)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4698 | eval created_by=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | table _time host created_by Task_Name

html.p: Severity 4. A PowerShell script contained download, decode or Defender-tampering code. Playbook steps (page 13) · Run the scope search

search.query: `windows_powershell` EventCode=4104 ("DownloadString" OR "DownloadFile" OR "Net.WebClient" OR "Invoke-WebRequest" OR "IEX" OR "Invoke-Expression" OR "FromBase64String" OR "Add-MpPreference" OR "Set-MpPreference" OR "MSFT_TaskIdleTrigger" OR "Invoke-Mimikatz" OR "AmsiUtils") | table _time host Message
`windows_system` EventCode=7045 | table _time host Service_Name Service_File_Name Service_Account

panel.title: Scripts and programs dropped in hiding spots

html.p: The folders the invitational red team's dropper used.

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=11 (TargetFilename="*ProgramData*Microsoft*Windows*WER*" OR TargetFilename="*ProgramData*Microsoft*Diagnosis*" OR TargetFilename="*Power Efficiency Diagnostics*" OR TargetFilename="*Windows*Temp*") (TargetFilename="*.js" OR TargetFilename="*.vbs" OR TargetFilename="*.ps1" OR TargetFilename="*.bat" OR TargetFilename="*.exe" OR TargetFilename="*.dll" OR TargetFilename="*.hta") | table _time host User Image TargetFilename
`windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 Image="*bitsadmin.exe" | table _time host User ParentImage CommandLine
